name: Sri Mariamman Temple, Singapore
scope: Standing Chinatown Sri Mariamman Temple complex with its street gopuram, main hall, four western sanctuary domes, walled forecourt and attached auxiliary roofs.
era: Present temple with the five-tier street tower and the 2023 conservation work.

references.caption: A line drawing of Sri Mariamman Temple in Singapore.
references.alt: A line drawing of Sri Mariamman Temple in Singapore.
categories: Gopuram of Sri Mariamman Temple, Singapore

originalReview.notes: The artist’s frontal line drawing shows five progressively narrower ornamental levels, a roof crest, repeated rows of sculpted figures, double timber doors, and the two flanking circular wall grilles.

review.method: Exact original Qualla drawing, native rights record, local heritage restoration reports and surveyed controls
review.notes: Reviewed the Qualla gallery first. Used Simon Fieldhouse’s signed public-domain drawing with exact native bytes and its original upload record. Photographs of the earlier three-tier tower and attribution-license photos do not control the standing gopuram.
